spans.s:
m. (-घः)
1 A cloud.
2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
3 A demon, a goblin.
E.
मिह to sprinkle, aff. अच्, and the final changed.

m. (-फः)
Hail.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and कफ phlegm.

m. (-लः)
The rains, the rainy season.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and काल time.

n. (-नं)
Thunder.
E.
मेघ, and गर्ज्जन noise.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Cloud-producing, (rainy season.)
E.
मेघ, कृ to make, खच् aff.

m. (-कः)
The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucus.)
E.
मेघ a cloud, चिन्तक who thinks of; being supposed to drink no water but rain, and therefore naturally anxious for cloudy and rainy weather.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Cloud-born, produced in or from the clouds.
m. (-जः)
A large pearl.
E.
मेघ, and ज born.

n. (-लं)
Talc.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and जाल a net; some copies read मेघनाल.

m. (-कः)
The Cātaka.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and जीवक living: see मेघचिन्तक.

m. (-तिः)
A flash of lightning or the fire of it.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and ज्योतिस् light.

n. (-रं)
Cloudiness, cloudy or rainy weather.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and तिमिर darkness.

m. (-पः)
Lightning.
E.
मेव a cloud, and दीप inflamer.

n. (-रं)
Sky, heaven, ether.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and द्वार the gate.

m. (-दः)
1 The son of RĀVAṆ

A name of VARUṆA, deity of water.
3 The noise or grumbling of clouds.
4 The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.)
5 A sort of amaranth, (Amaranthus polygamus.)
E.
मेघ a cloud, and नाद sound or noise.

m. (-जित्)
LAKṢMAṆA, the favourite brother and companion of RĀMA.
E.
मघनाद the son of RĀVAṆA, and जित् conqueror.

m. (-सी)
A peacock.
E.
मेघनाद the muttering of clouds, अनुलस to be delighted by, and णिनि aff.; pairing in the rainy season.

m. (-मा)
A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
E.
मेघ a cloud; and नामन् appellation, or it may apply to every term for a cloud, being a synonym of the grass.

m. (-षः)
The muttering or grumbling of clouds, low or distant thunder.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and निर्घोष sound, noise.

Water.
2

River water.
3 Hail.
m. (-ष्पः)
One of VIṢṆU'S horses.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and पुष्प a flower.

m. (-वः)
Water.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and प्रसव a parent.

m. (-तिः)
The thunderbolt.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and भूति being.

f. (-ला)
A gathering or succession of clouds.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and माला a necklace or garland.

m. (-निः)
Smoke.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and योनि place of birth or production.

m. (-गः)
One of the six modes of music.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and राग mode; being supposed capable of bringing down rain from heaven.

f. (-र्णा)
The indigo plant.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and वर्ण colour.

n. (-र्त्म)
Sky, atmosphere.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and वर्त्मन् road.

m. (-ह्निः)
The fire of lightning, or electrical coruscations in the clouds.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and वह्नि fire.

m. (-नः)
1 A name of

INDRA.
2

ŚIVA.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and वाहन vehicle.

Thunder.
2

A species of the Atidhṛti metre.
E.
मेघ, and विस्फुर्ज्जित bursting.

n. (-श्म)
Sky, atmosphere.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and वेश्मन् abode.

m. (-हृद्)
A peacock.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and सुहृद् a friend.

m. (-मः)
The rains, the rainy season.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and आगम arrival.

m. (-न्दी)
A peacock.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and आनन्दिन् delighting.

n. (-स्थि)
Hail.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and अस्थि a bone.

n. (-दं)
Heaven, ether, sky, atmosphere.
E.
मेघ a cloud, and आस्पद place.

m. (-रः)
The father of the fifth Jina or Jaina saint.
